title: SOMEBODY WON! (it’s us, we all won) @New York City Center #intheheights
transcript: New York City centre continuing this trend of just doing my absolute favourite musicals for their gala performances. I cannot believe we are getting in the Heights this fall from October 28th to November 8th. This is so huge to me. In the Heights is one of my favourite musicals. My mom and I were lucky enough to see it 18 years ago practically to the day in the front row centre of the Rogers Theatre. I have not been the same since. And I cannot wait to sit in New York city centre and experience this again. I am also so excited for people who have only seen the movie version to be able to experience the stage version which has some of my favourite moments in it. I cannot wait to see who they cast in this. And this is just a reminder that if you are under the age of 40, you do not need 96,000 dollars to go afford tickets to this. You can in fact get 28 dollar tickets. All you have to do is go online to their website, verify your age and it's. It's incredibly affordable to go see a show in New York city centre. And I, I know I do not wanna miss this. And just throwing it out there that I need the New York City centre social account to recreate at least one of the iconic Usnavi videos. Just one, any one Or make a new parody. But I need. I need it in my Life, please
